hypotheses.criterion: U1 dynamic range exceeds U2 by a clear margin with every adjacent P5 step beyond 2 combined SEs over 30 draws per rung.
hypotheses.observed: P5 ladder U1 N0 mean dynamicRange 0.0291 vs U2 0.0074 (4.0x); weakest adjacent step +8.97 SE vs +1.28; 9+1 vs 8+2 step +11.94 SE vs +2.44; Spearman vs supervised 1.0 on 11 rungs.
hypotheses.rationale: Descriptive PoC reading at full pilot scale (30 draws per rung, endpoints deterministic); no significance file is cited, which is a warning at poc and mandatory only at full.
hypotheses.statement: The per-annotator neighborhood consistency unit (Eq. 9) separates contamination levels better than the panel-consensus variant.
hypotheses.test: adjacent-step separation beyond 2 combined SEs, 30 draws per rung

hypotheses.criterion: Mean separates most P5 steps and the lower decile fires earliest at low contamination.
hypotheses.observed: Mean separates 8/10 P5 steps; q10 early alarm over c<=3 reaches +20.21 SE at step 0->1 and +42.36 SE over c<=3, then saturates (3/10 verdicts); S2p percentile compresses the tail by construction.
hypotheses.rationale: Mean is the primary panel score and q10 the complementary early alarm, as closed in r10; q10 saturation is read as complement, not failure.
hypotheses.statement: The panel score is the mean of per-annotator consistencies with the lower decile as complementary early alarm.
hypotheses.test: same separation rule as H1, read per summary

hypotheses.criterion: U2 bias ladder stays flat while supervised quality drops, and the consistent-bias P3 pool reads between P1 and P5 rather than as wrong.
hypotheses.metric: P3 bias ladder and supervised mIoU
hypotheses.observed: P3 arm U2 dynamicRange 0.0014 with 0/10 verdicts while supervised mean drops 0.128 on P3 (0.330 on P5); U1 N0 mean reads the P3 pool 0.0101 below P1 with its bias ladder still opening.
hypotheses.rationale: Confirms the declared scope A6: consistency is not correctness; a consistently biased panel reads as consistent.
hypotheses.statement: Neighborhood consistency measures agreement stability, not correctness against ground truth.
hypotheses.test: same separation rule; supervised column validates only

hypotheses.criterion: No candidate is declared winner from the 5-seed pilot alone; the selection is closed by deliberation in r10.
hypotheses.observed: Selection pilot ran 5 seeds per cell (105 runs) below the 30-seed verdict floor; design round compares S1/S2/S3 arms over the same worlds; r10 publishes C3 (Eq. 7) as constraint and soft gating of Eq. 1 as design.
hypotheses.rationale: Pilot scale cannot decide by its own rule, so the verdict is inconclusive by test and decided by the r10 deliberation that cites this pilot as input.
hypotheses.statement: The identifiability constraint is the coupled likelihood alone (Eq. 7) with soft gating of Eq. 1 as the design.
hypotheses.test: 30-seed floor not met at pilot scale

limitations: PoC scale only: synthetic pilot ran 5 seeds per cell, below the 30-seed verdict floor, so H4 is inconclusive by test.
Port fidelity above tolerance: maxAbsDiff 0.0056 vs 0.001 against the prototype CSV (unknown prototype device, port on CPU); shape reproduces (0.7995->0.7921 vs 0.7984->0.7865).
Real-data arms of v02 (RIGA, OxfordIIITPet, refresh and per-annotator-threshold arms, equal-budget pruning) are not run here.
No significance files are cited at poc; significance comparisons become mandatory at full.

novelty.claim: CT-GCE with per-category truncation plus coupled reliability (Eq. 7, soft gating Eq. 1) and the zero-GT neighborhood consistency metric (Eqs. 8-9, per-annotator unit, mean panel score with decile alarm).
novelty.rationale: Pilots support the unit, summary, scope and selections as closed in r10, but real-data gains over majority/STAPLE/CrowdSeg on RIGA and OxfordIIITPet are still unmeasured under v02, so the claim is only partly justified at poc.

qualitative_not_applicable: No saliency, embedding or error-case figure was produced in the synthetic and metric pilots; both pilots are numeric ladders (consistency and recovery statistics) and their readings are the tables in Results/*.json. Qualitative figures are owed by the v02 real-data runs that declare interpretability, not by this poc.
summary: PoC closes the r10 selections on measured pilot evidence: the per-annotator NLC unit spans 0.0291 vs 0.0074 for panel consensus (4.0x, weakest step +8.97 SE vs +1.28) with mean panel score plus decile early alarm, consistent bias reads as consistent (scope holds), and the synthetic pilots feed the r10 choice of Eq. 7 with soft gating. Real-data proof under v02 is still open.

contribution_type.why: H1 supported (U1 dynamicRange 0.0291 vs U2 0.0074, weakest step +8.97 SE) and H3 supported establish the per-annotator unit and scope on synthetic/metric pilots; H2 partially_supported (mean 8/10, q10 saturates) and H4 inconclusive (5 seeds/cell below 30-seed floor) plus novelty partially_justified with v02 RIGA/OxfordIIITPet gains still unmeasured confine the claim to pilot-scale feasibility.

Concept & Feasibility.why: Synthetic/metric pilots demonstrate the Eq.9 unit and Eq.7 choice at PoC scale with real-data validation explicitly open; classic pilot-feasibility shape.

Use-Inspired.why: Targets real crowd-segmentation use (RIGA, OxfordIIITPet) but PoC evidence is synthetic ladders only; fit in use not yet demonstrated.

General.why: Requires full 30-seed real-data wins over majority/STAPLE/CrowdSeg which discussion records as still open under v02.

Theory.why: Carries Eqs.1/7/9 and coupling derivative but verifies them empirically at pilot scale, not via proof correctness as primary evidence.

Negative Results.why: No central hypothesis is not_supported; H1/H3 supported, H2 partial, H4 inconclusive by scale, not a surprising failure with deeper analysis.
